text:
Maya: Heads up — dozens of GPU node launches in us-west-2 failing over the last 10m. Autoscaler spikes from 5 -> 35 and we get EC2 errors: "Client.Throttling: security group rules quota exceeded". Affected: batch-inference-prod. /cc @Liam
Liam: :eyes: any logs or example errors?
Maya: Copy of the agent log: ```Apr 12 14:02:03 kubelet[1234]: error creating instance i-0abc...: Client.Throttling: security group rules quota exceeded
	status code: 400, request id: 9f8a-...
Apr 12 14:02:04 autoscaler: launch failed for nodepool-gpu-3: API error modify-network-interfaces: RequestLimitExceeded
```
Liam: Are we creating/modifying SGs per instance or reusing a pool?
Maya: Our infra pattern currently creates per-cluster SGs and the node bootstrap path calls `ModifyNetworkInterfaces` to attach extra SGs during launch. That path issues many SG-modify calls in parallel — looks like the throttle point.
Sophia: AWS has both ENI attach/modify rate limits and security group rule-change/change rate limits. Support will often recommend batching or reusing SGs. Did we get a support response?
Maya: Opened ticket 0123456789. AWS replied that we're hitting their per-account security-group modification rate, not the static rule quota. They recommended either pre-creating the final SG sets or reducing parallel modify calls.
Kyle: Short-term mitigations: 1) throttle autoscaler concurrency (reduce parallel node launches to ~5), 2) pin a slice of capacity for immediate needs, 3) stagger rollout windows. Medium-term: change launch path to use a stable set of SGs in the launch template so we don't call ModifyNetworkInterfaces per instance. Long-term: request a throughput uplift for SG modifications and ENI attach quotas.
Liam: Can we flip an autoscaler config quickly? Where's the config stored?
Maya: It's in infra/k8s/cluster-autoscaler/values.yaml. Proposed quick patch: ```scaleUp:
  maxParallel: 5
  maxSurge: 2
```I'll open a PR now, plan to canary today.
Sophia: Note that reducing parallelism will increase scale time and could backlog short-lived batch jobs — tag queues for owners. Also watch costs for longer-running instances while we scale slower.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: PR #987 merged by Maya into canary — rolling change to cluster-autoscaler config.
Kyle: Also a config check: ensure we aren't running an external script that calls `aws ec2 modify-instance-attribute` after launch. If so, switch to specifying security groups in the launch template or ENI definition.
Maya: Confirmed an old bootstrap hook uses `aws ec2 modify-network-interface-attribute` to add SGs for metrics routing. I'll remove that and bake SGs into the template.
Liam: After the changes, watch for RequestLimitExceeded or new throttles. If AWS keeps throttling, escalate the support case and ask for pre-warming for our expected burst pattern.
Maya: Filed quota request/link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/home#/case/?caseId=123-aws — AWS acknowledged, estimated 72h.
Kyle: I'll add a task to infra board and loop in on-call for the scaling window tomorrow 09:00 PT. Also consider adding a circuit-breaker to the autoscaler so it backs off earlier when launch failures spike.
Maya: Thanks everyone — rolling the canary now. Will post back metrics (launch success / error rate) in ~30m. :thumbsup:
